newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Corp plans petrol stations in Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Corp plans petrol stations in Taiwan.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corp said on Friday it plans to open petrol stations in Taiwan over the next several years, capitalising on the deregulation of the oil market there.
The trading house hopes to set up a joint venture company in Taiwan by the end of this year with a Taiwanese partner to carry out the plan, a Mitsubishi spokesman said.
Mitsubishi Corp is in the final stage of selecting a partner from among several candidates, he said.
The trading house's wholly owned subsidiary Mitsubishi Syoji Sekiyu Co Ltd, which operates about 700 gasoline stations in Japan, will also have a stake in the venture, he said.

The spokesman also said that Western Petro Diamond Private Co Ltd of India, owned equally by Mitsubishi Corp and India's Western India Group, plans to build a 30,000 kilolitre kerosene storage tank near Bombay by the end of the year, he said.
